releaseGate.reason: The owned source and constrained runtime profile are assembled, but the integrated candidate still requires fresh exact Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 compilation, attended native settings/Biology/Outfit/HUD/gameplay/save/quest/performance acceptance, final calibration and final archive/notices/checksum verification before a public playable release.

components.notes: Only the accepted runtime payload belongs in a player artifact; tests, reports, staging and source-only tooling stay out.
Required script loader/compiler plumbing for the owned runtime. Bundle the pinned official Windows payload and required MIT notice in the final one-download package after live acceptance.
Required generic dependency of the pinned ArchiveXL/Mod Settings plumbing. RED4ext owns no RealPass gameplay policy.
Required by the pinned Mod Settings release used for the accepted RealPass settings surface. ArchiveXL owns no RealPass gameplay policy or resources.
No current RealPass production source/data path requires TweakXL.
The owned dynamic Biology/nameplate UI uses native Ink/REDscript APIs and has no Codeware import.
Provides the accepted RealPass presence/read-only feature ledger and binary presentation/accessibility preference surface. It does not own body, injury, combat, armor or other simulation policy.
The current owned runtime adds no custom input binding requiring Input Loader.
Historical research/provenance may remain in the repository, but executing Dark Future content is forbidden from owned/live/public RealPass candidates.
Accepted presentation behavior is recreated with RealPass-owned source plus stock Cyberpunk UI. Original/modified Project E3 runtime assets remain forbidden from the standalone artifact.
No Cyberpunk executable, stock archives, compiled cache, saves or user settings enter a RealPass artifact.

artifactRequirements: Game-root-relative paths only for runtime payload.

The final artifact contains only allowed runtime components: project-original RealPass payload plus the pinned redscript, RED4ext, ArchiveXL and Mod Settings runtime selected by the accepted deployment profile.
A short INSTALL.txt at the archive root explains game-root extraction, ordinary Steam launch and uninstall/repair expectations.
A VERSION/BUILD identifier and SHA-256 checksum are generated deterministically.
Required licenses and third-party notices for every bundled generic dependency plus RealPass notices are included without development-only files.
The artifact content list is generated and verified before upload.
Blocked or not-required components cause the public-playable release job to fail closed rather than silently expanding the dependency stack.
